title: Take It Easy
lyrics:
[00:00.000] 作词 : Glenn Frey/Jackson Browne
[00:01.000] 作曲 : Glenn Frey/Jackson Browne
[00:16.927]Well I'm a-running down the road
[00:18.917]Tryin' to loosen my load
[00:20.607]I've got seven women on my mind
[00:24.480]Four that wanna own me
[00:25.927]Two that wanna stone me
[00:27.920]One says she's a friend of mine
[00:30.678]Take it easy take it easy
[00:37.677]Don't let the sound of your own wheels drive you crazy
[00:44.177]Lighten up while you still can
[00:47.928]Don't even try to understand
[00:51.428]Just find a place to make your stand
[00:54.428]And take it easy
[01:01.428]Well I'm a-standing on a corner
[01:03.678]In Winslow Arizona
[01:05.678]Such a fine sight to see
[01:08.678]It's a girl my Lord
[01:10.428]In a flat-bed Ford
[01:11.930]Slowin' down to take a look at me
[01:15.179]Come on baby
[01:18.895]Don't say maybe
[01:22.123]I gotta know
[01:23.573]If your sweet love
[01:25.624]Is gonna save me
[01:29.623]We may lose and we may win
[01:32.623]Though we will never be here again
[01:35.874]So open up I'm climbin' in
[01:39.124]So take it easy
[02:11.124]Well I'm running down the road
[02:12.874]Trying to loosen my load
[02:14.374]Got a world of trouble on my mind
[02:18.124]Lookin' for a lover
[02:19.874]Who won't blow my cover
[02:21.374]She's so hard to find
[02:24.625]Take it easy take it easy
[02:31.874]Don't let the sound of your own
[02:34.125]Wheels make you crazy
[02:38.625]Come on baby
[02:41.798]Don't say maybe
[02:45.317]I gotta know
[02:47.801]If your sweet love
[02:49.001]Is gonna save me
[03:09.752]Oh we got it easy
[03:16.752]We oughta take it easy
